name: ENKI Language Vocabulary
description: Canonical vocabulary for writing systems, phonology, morphology, semantics, pragmatics, script glyph coverage markers, AND (v0.2.0, 2026-05-14) frozen base-60 addresses for closed-set vocabulary. Frozen addresses make cross-ENKI form-layer dictionaries mergeable by SQL union instead of name-reconciliation. See the internal base60 cyclical language model notes. v0.3.0 (2026-07-25): declares language.exceptions (4,416 irregular inflection->base-lemma entries from oewn:2023, the data half of core/language/lemmatizer.py). Shipped on disk since May 2026 but never manifest-declared, so it sat outside pack governance. Its `type` was the non-schema value 'morphology_exceptions' and its `version` was the lexicon tag 'oewn-2023' (not semver); both are now schema-valid with the lexicon tag preserved as metadata.source_lexicon.
